tools.name: decline_team_invitation

tools.name: delete_transfer
tools.description: Permanently delete a transfer from the account, archived or not, with its timeline. It cannot be undone; archiving keeps the transfer instead. Adding the UETR again later starts a new transfer.

tools.name: delete_webhook_endpoint

tools.name: get_account

tools.name: get_billing_link

The link stays the same for the life of the transfer, so share it only with people who should follow it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_share_link, get_watcher_count, invite_team_member, share_payment_record · Private data: change_webhook_endpoint_url, create_webhook_endpoint, decline_team_invitation, delete_webhook_endpoint, export_transfers, get_account, get_payment_record, get_watcher_count, get_webhook_endpoint, invite_team_member, list_pending_access, list_team_members, list_webhook_deliveries, list_webhook_endpoints, recheck_transfer, remove_team_member, rename_transfer, resend_team_invitation, rotate_webhook_secret, send_webhook_test, set_check_frequency, share_payment_record, update_transfer, update_webhook_endpoint · Public sink: change_webhook_endpoint_url, create_webhook_endpoint, delete_webhook_endpoint, get_share_link, get_watcher_count, get_webhook_endpoint, invite_team_member, list_pending_access, list_team_members, list_webhook_deliveries, list_webhook_endpoints, resend_team_invitation, rotate_webhook_secret, send_webhook_test, share_payment_record, update_webhook_endpoint · Destructive: decline_team_invitation, delete_transfer, delete_webhook_endpoint, remove_team_member, restore_transfer, set_check_frequency.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_share_link, get_watcher_count, invite_team_member, share_payment_record · Private data: change_webhook_endpoint_url, create_webhook_endpoint, decline_team_invitation, delete_webhook_endpoint, export_transfers, get_account, get_payment_record, get_watcher_count, get_webhook_endpoint, invite_team_member, list_pending_access, list_team_members, list_webhook_deliveries, list_webhook_endpoints, recheck_transfer, remove_team_member, rename_transfer, resend_team_invitation, rotate_webhook_secret, send_webhook_test, set_check_frequency, share_payment_record, update_transfer, update_webhook_endpoint · Public sink: change_webhook_endpoint_url, create_webhook_endpoint, delete_webhook_endpoint, get_share_link, get_watcher_count, get_webhook_endpoint, invite_team_member, list_pending_access, list_team_members, list_webhook_deliveries, list_webhook_endpoints, resend_team_invitation, rotate_webhook_secret, send_webhook_test, share_payment_record, update_webhook_endpoint · Destructive: decline_team_invitation, delete_transfer, delete_webhook_endpoint, remove_team_member, restore_transfer, set_check_frequency

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
